strings.notes: 里香 not in 0719; US contact Lass Dana (US 0700); not the same person as 阿香 (D-0465)

strings.zh: 你的精灵还真是厉害啊！{SCROLL}⋯⋯对战后的男孩子{NEWLINE}有时会给我些道具什么的,{CLEAR}不过也不是每次都有的,{SCROLL}下次我有得到的话再给你吧,{NEWLINE}所以把你的电话号码给我吧！{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Your Pokémon are really strong!{SCROLL}...Boys sometimes give me items after{NEWLINE}our battles. Not every time, though.{SCROLL}Next time I get something, I’ll give it{NEWLINE}to you. So give me your phone number!{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 下次我要是拿到了{NEWLINE}什么东西我就给你,{SCROLL}我可不是你想的那种坏女孩！
strings.en: Next time I get something,{NEWLINE}I’ll give it to you.{SCROLL}I’m not the kind of bad{NEWLINE}girl you think I am!

strings.zh: 你不要吗？{NEWLINE}人家难得想给你的⋯⋯
strings.en: Aww, you don’t want it? And I hardly{NEWLINE}ever feel like giving stuff away...
strings.notes: US 0700/3 | RV073: meaning: 人家难得想给你的 = I rarely want to give; not 'it's all for free'

strings.zh: 我以后会和你分享礼物的！{SCROLL}你乐意的话,能告诉我{NEWLINE}你的电话号码吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: I’ll share my gifts with you.{SCROLL}Let me get your phone number.{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 你是来拿礼物的吗？{SCROLL}我想这个会对你{NEWLINE}有所帮助的！给！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Are you here for your gift?{SCROLL}I think this will really help you! Here!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 我说,你不觉得{NEWLINE}女孩子打电话的样子{CLEAR}非常有魅力吗？{SCROLL}不是？{SCROLL}嘿嘿,你现在就在附近偷看我吧？{NEWLINE}为什么不{CLEAR}直接来找我聊天呢！
strings.en: Hey, tell me, don’t you think that the{NEWLINE}sight of a girl on the phone is charming?{SCROLL}It’s not?{SCROLL}Ha ha ha, you’re nearby, sneaking a{NEWLINE}peek at me, aren’t you? Why not come{CLEAR}over here and talk in person?
strings.notes: US 0700/6 | RV073: omission: restored 偷看我 (sneaking a peek at me); settles D-1902

strings.zh: 最近我的{VAR:0100:10}{NEWLINE}越来越可爱了。{CLEAR}我现在有好多它的照片了！{SCROLL}还有还有,{NEWLINE}之前我瞬间就打倒了{CLEAR}{VAR:0100:11}！{SCROLL}这应该是因为我现在的对战技术{NEWLINE}越来越娴熟的缘故吧？{SCROLL}拜拜！
strings.en: My {VAR:0100:10} keeps getting cuter.{NEWLINE}I have so many pictures of it now!{SCROLL}And guess what? The other day we{NEWLINE}beat a {VAR:0100:11} in an instant!{SCROLL}I guess my battling skills are{NEWLINE}getting better and better?{SCROLL}Later!

strings.zh: 最近,我的{VAR:0100:10}{NEWLINE}越来越可爱了。{CLEAR}我现在有好多它的照片了！{SCROLL}还有还有,{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11}又跑掉了,{CLEAR}真是好可惜啊！{CLEAR}真的就差那么一点点了！{SCROLL}拜拜！
strings.en: My {VAR:0100:10} is getting cuter! I’ve{NEWLINE}been taking tons of pictures!{SCROLL}You know what? A wild {VAR:0100:11} got{NEWLINE}away from me again.{SCROLL}It was so close! Really, just a little{NEWLINE}bit more, and I would’ve...{SCROLL}Later!
strings.notes: US 0700/8 | RV073: meaning: 可爱 = cuter, parallel with #7

strings.zh: 话说,我现在{NEWLINE}就在{VAR:0104:3},{SCROLL}要是你来到这附近的话,{NEWLINE}我们再战一场好吗！{CLEAR}我等着你！
strings.en: Right now, I’m on {VAR:0104:3}.{SCROLL}If you’re close by, let’s battle!{NEWLINE}I’ll be waiting for you!

strings.zh: 你应该没忘记我们{NEWLINE}精灵对战的约定吧,{SCROLL}我在{VAR:0104:3}等你！
strings.en: Hi! You haven’t forgotten about your{NEWLINE}promise to battle me, have you?{SCROLL}I’m waiting on {VAR:0104:3}!

strings.zh: 啊,你要礼物？{NEWLINE}虽然我已经得到了,{CLEAR}不过这个我自己也要用,{SCROLL}你就再等等吧！
strings.en: Oh! You wanted a gift, right?{NEWLINE}I got one, but I want to keep this.{SCROLL}Can you wait a bit longer?

strings.zh: 我得到好东西了！{NEWLINE}之前答应过你的{CLEAR}这个就送给你吧！{SCROLL}呵呵,你要想要的话{NEWLINE}那就来{VAR:0104:3}拿吧！
strings.en: You know what? I got a good gift!{NEWLINE}As I promised, it’s yours!{SCROLL}I’m sure you’ll like it. Come and pick it{NEWLINE}up! I’m waiting on {VAR:0104:3}!

strings.zh: 喂喂？{SCROLL}你要是再不快点来拿的话,{NEWLINE}我就送给别人了哦！{SCROLL}我在{VAR:0104:3}{NEWLINE}等你！
strings.en: Hello?{SCROLL}If you don’t come and get your present{NEWLINE}soon, I’ll give it to someone else.{SCROLL}I’m waiting on {VAR:0104:3}!
